easyPrerequisites: You have a way to draw a card.
description:
Draw a card.
Shabraz and Wizard Class trigger for each card drawn.
Resolve all Shabraz triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and put a +1/+1 counter on Shabraz for each trigger.
Resolve the first Wizard Class trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on Fetid Gargantua.
Fetid Gargantua triggers, causing you to draw two cards and lose 2 life.
Repeat from step 2.
